achievements.name: Meta-Hacking
achievements.description: Hack the game itself: back up scripts.zip, edit client/states/state-main-menu.lua to uncomment the KLEIAchievements:achieve( "META_HACKING" ) line, blank hashes.dat to 0 bytes, and relaunch. Klei intended this achievement to be earned by modifying the game files.
